item.title: Overhanging trees and ivy, 16th August
item.description:
Brook Lane : overhanging tree branches and ivy. Has progressively got worse over the last year. The gap between the vegetation and the pavement is now 4 foot (1.2m) and is across the whole pavement walking area. People are walking in the road to go around this obstruction. Brook Lane is the B13 bus route so not safe to walk in the road. Please can this be pruned back or inform the residents of Grosvenor Road who own the trees etc. positioned at the rear perimeter of their garden. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Brook Lane, Blendon, Greater London
